faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about CarpoolWork.
faq.noResults: No results found for your search.
faq.stillNeedHelpDesc: Our support team is available 7 days a week to assist you.

safety.a1: Your safety is our top priority. Every driver must verify their identity and driver's license with biometric checks. All trips are tracked in real-time, and we provide an in-app SOS button that immediately contacts emergency services and shares your location.
safety.a2: Yes. Every driver goes through a multi-step verification: government ID verification, driver's license validation, and biometric selfie match. We also monitor driver ratings and can suspend accounts that fall below safety standards.
safety.q3: What happens if I feel unsafe during a trip?
safety.a3: Use the SOS button in the app at any time. It will alert our safety team and share your GPS location with local emergency services. You can also share your live trip details with a trusted contact before departure.
safety.q4: Is there insurance coverage during trips?
safety.a4: All trips are covered by the driver's personal auto insurance, which in Canada must include liability coverage for passengers. We strongly recommend drivers confirm their policy covers carpooling. CarpoolWork does not provide additional insurance at this time.
safety.q5: What if my driver is discriminatory or harassing?
safety.a5: We have a zero-tolerance policy for discrimination and harassment. Report any incident through the app immediately. We investigate all reports within 24 hours and will permanently ban offending users. Your safety and dignity are non-negotiable.

payments.a1: Payment is hybrid. The trip price is paid directly to the driver (cash, Interac e-Transfer, or any agreed method). A $1.99 (taxes included) service fee is charged via Stripe at booking for passengers only. Drivers pay no fees.
payments.a2: A $1.99 (taxes included) service fee per booking, for passengers only. That's it. Registration is free and drivers pay nothing. This is the lowest fee structure in Canada — competitors charge 15-20% commission.
payments.a3: Cancellation more than 24 hours before departure: service fee refunded in full. Cancellation within 24 hours: service fee is non-refundable. If the driver cancels, the service fee is always refunded automatically. Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days.
payments.a4: Passengers pay the driver directly on the day of the trip (cash, Interac, etc.). The driver receives 100% of the trip price with no middleman and no commission.
payments.a5: Nothing! Drivers pay no fees at all. Registration, trip publishing, and trip completion are completely free. Drivers keep 100% of the trip price. Only passengers pay a $1.99 (taxes included) service fee per booking.

trips.q1: How do I book a ride?
trips.a1: Search by entering your departure city, destination, and date. Browse available rides, check driver profiles and reviews, then book and pay securely online. You'll receive a confirmation with the driver's contact details.
trips.q2: How do I offer a ride as a driver?
trips.a2: Create an account, verify your identity and license, then publish a trip with your route, date, time, available seats, and price per seat. Passengers will find your trip when searching.
trips.q3: What if my driver doesn't show up?
trips.a3: If the driver is a no-show, you'll receive a full automatic refund. Report the incident in the app so we can take action on the driver's account. Repeated no-shows result in account suspension.
trips.q4: Can I message the driver before booking?
trips.a4: Yes! Our built-in messaging system lets you contact the driver before booking to ask about pickup details, luggage space, or any other questions.
trips.a5: CarpoolWork operates across all of Canada. Popular routes include Toronto–Montreal, Vancouver–Victoria, Calgary–Edmonton, Ottawa–Montreal, and many more. If there's no ride on your route, offer one!

cancellations.a1: Free cancellation more than 24 hours before departure — the service fee is refunded in full. Cancellation within 24 hours: the service fee is non-refundable. If the driver cancels, your service fee is always refunded automatically.
cancellations.q2: What if the driver cancels my trip?
cancellations.a2: You'll receive a full automatic refund and a notification immediately. We apologize for the inconvenience — driver cancellations hurt the experience for everyone and repeated offenders are penalized.
cancellations.q3: Can I get a refund if the trip was bad?
cancellations.a3: If you had a serious issue during the trip (safety concern, major detour, vehicle condition), contact our support team within 48 hours. We review each case individually and can issue partial or full refunds.

account.q1: How do I create an account?
account.a1: Sign up with your email address or Google account. It takes less than 2 minutes. You'll need to provide your name, email, and phone number. Optional identity verification unlocks all features.
account.a2: Basic account: email and phone. To book or offer rides: government ID and biometric selfie. For drivers: add your Canadian driver's license. Verification is quick — usually completed within 2-5 minutes.
account.q3: Can I delete my account and data?
account.a3: Yes, absolutely. Under PIPEDA (Canada's privacy law), you have the right to request deletion of your personal data. Go to Profile > Privacy > Delete Account. Your data will be removed within 30 days, except financial records retained for 7 years per Canadian tax law.
account.a4: You can sign in with your email and password, or use Google Sign-In for faster access. Both methods are equally secure.

support.a1: Use the chat widget on this page for instant answers. For complex issues, email support@canadacarpooling.ca — we respond within 24 hours, 7 days a week.
support.q2: How do I report a problem?
support.a2: In the app: go to your trip > Report Issue. You can report safety concerns, no-shows, payment problems, or inappropriate behavior. All reports are reviewed within 24 hours.
support.q3: What languages is support available in?
support.a3: Our platform and support are fully bilingual in English and French, reflecting Canada's official languages.

general.a1: After each trip, both driver and passenger can leave reviews. Reviews include ratings for punctuality, safety, communication, and comfort. Reviews are public and help the community make informed choices.
general.a2: Yes. Carpooling — sharing costs of a trip you're already taking — is legal across Canada. Drivers cannot profit; they can only share the cost of gas, tolls, and wear. We enforce this by recommending fair prices.
general.q3: How is CarpoolWork different from competitors?
general.a3: A service fee of only $1.99 (taxes included) per booking for passengers only — drivers pay nothing (competitors charge 15-20% commission). Drivers keep 100% of the trip price — paid directly with no middleman. Bilingual support, Canadian-first design, SOS button, and full PIPEDA compliance.
